findings.title: Create the queued timestamp per assignment source
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when this module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` instance gets the same timestamp rather than the time that assignment source was created. That stale value is included in the serialized task payload, making the queued time inaccurate for every later inbound assignment. Use a dataclass `default_factory` so each instance gets its own timestamp.
